title: Slate documentation manifest
description: Contract between Content and Shell. Accepts a v1 array of entries or a v2 object with version, optional config, and entries.

path.description: Relative path to a .md, .html, or .canvas.json file, or an absolute URL when type is 'external'.

title.description: Nav and tab title. Derived from the first H1 when omitted.

order.description: Ascending sort within the entry's group or folder.

group.description: Explicit nav section label; overrides folder-derived grouping.

icon.description: Material Symbol name (e.g. 'home', 'flag') rendered via the Material Symbols font; overrides the default nav file icon.

status.description: Authoring status shown as a colored nav dot and a page-meta pill. Recognized values (styled): 'stub', 'planned', 'draft', 'wip', 'review', 'pending', 'deciding', 'stable', 'published', 'done'. Any other string renders with a neutral dot and a capitalized label.

updated.description: Last-updated timestamp (ISO 8601 date or date-time). Rendered as a relative time (e.g. 'updated 3 days ago') in the nav tooltip and page-meta bar; falls back to an absolute date beyond ~11 months.

hidden.description: Omit from nav but keep searchable and deep-linkable.

open.description: Canvas v1 always opens in a separate full-viewport tab.

searchText.description: Optional validated summary used by reader search without loading the Canvas bundle.

motion.description: Relative path from the presentation page to a versioned Slate motion manifest.
